method: Opened all 12 prospective style images individually at original resolution before receiving this completed DeepSeek/mean snapshot, then inspected the newly queued document R0331 individually. Nonblind paired diagnostic adjudication covers all 49 prepared comparisons; image-only observations are preserved separately. No primary scores, eligibility labels, model scores, prompts or protected selections were changed. Directional visual rationale does not validate an exact numerical increment, and minor differences often remain ambiguous.

verdict_definitions.visibly_justified: At least one task change has a visible rationale and neither task has a confirmed regression.
verdict_definitions.regression: At least one task or declared eligibility floor has a visually supported regression.
verdict_definitions.ambiguous: The differences cannot be resolved confidently from visible evidence; unchanged scores are retained explicitly.
